claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: DMP-543 is a Kv7 (KCNQ) potassium channel blocker that enhances acetylcholine release; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its pharmacology is neuromodulatory rather than antiproliferative.
